Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:

  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security DB confirms Maurice Perez (E036) is a contractor with basic security training, not advanced. Per policy, contractors may have write only with advanced training, so maximum is read. Requested write exceeds max; recommend read.
reason: Maurice Perez (E036) is a contractor Engineer with basic security training (not advanced). Per policy, contractors may have read, or write only with advanced security training. content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee Maurice Perez (E036) requests write access to Source Code.

Facts:
- Role: Engineer
- Employment type: contractor
- Security training: basic (not advanced)

Policy:
- contractor employees: read, or write if they have advanced security training. Never admin.

So maximum for this contractor is read (since no advanced training).

Requested: write. Requested level is above maximum, so grant maximum = read.

Decision: read.
